review_kind: AI editorial merge-integrity review of already-read generated drafts; not independent historical verification
method: Compared every non-editorial paragraph of ancient-party-part.md, ancient-supplement-part.md and hu-shih-part.md against the integrated draft. Exact matches were mechanically verified; nonexact replacements and shared sections were read. Checked source-derived plan obligations, reversal conditions and editorial attribution. Searched specific missing mechanisms rather than rereading source books.
counting_rule: Han characters U+3400–U+9FFF, excluding headings and bracketed source references. Shared final sections are measured as actual integrated carriers of assigned mechanisms; this is not a claim that every character was newly authored by this agent and must not be added again to another agent's output total. Attribution notes are not used to fill substantive lower bounds.
overall: Main and supplement mechanisms, reversal conditions and source-derived lower bounds are now carried by the integrated draft. Zhou and the composite literary summary were safely merged; Hu Shih is separate and both Hu Feng paragraphs survive. Root restored the initially omitted protection/community mechanism with Wang Yongjiang/Chen Lianbo and Chiang survival-feedback mechanism. Two pre-existing original subsection shortfalls—Wang Jingwei and Fu Zuoyi—were explicitly repaired with already-read substantive increments; they are no longer hidden by aggregate surplus. No original budget or plan was changed.
